name: 深度云海 GEO 专家

description.zh: 用配置好的账号查询、核对并修改 GEO 多站点内容后台的文章数据。安装后专家页出现该卡片，聘用即以该专家的组合开启新对话。
description.en: Queries, checks, and updates articles on the GEO multi-site content backend with the configured account. After install, the expert page shows the card and hiring starts a session composed as the expert.
